messages:
nina: heads up 7 new hire Priya S got an 'address mismatch' flag on background check. start date Friday. do we push or try remote verify?
ben (recruiter): candidate's flexible. she's currently between apartments and can upload a bank stmt or gov mail by tomorrow morning. wants to keep Fri if possible.
mara (onboarding): remote I-9 ok via certified agent. we need clear photo ID + proof of address dated within 60 days. suggest deadline Thu 5pm to avoid delaying Fri start.
oliver (it): laptop can be shipped to alternate address (friend/hotel) but need written confirmation from candidate with delivery address + phone. we hold shipment until sign-off. sample tracking format: `TRACK123456789`.
ben (recruiter): asked for driver's license front/back + bank stmt. candidate sent license pic at 1812345700 and will email stmt by 1812346000.
nina: if docs arrive Thu by 5pm, we run verification and grant provisional onboarding access on Fri AM (no VPN/repos). full access once final doc confirmed.
onboard-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Check Priya S docs" at 1812412800.
mara (onboarding): I'll send the provisional onboarding invite and the I-9 instructions now: https://redwood.example/onboard/i9?hire=PriyaS
oliver (it): create a limited test account if she needs to access staging. no SSO until final clearance.
ben (recruiter): confirmed, candidate will send bank stmt tonight. will update thread when done.
nina: thanks team 44d we'll re-evaluate at 1812346000.
